events.description: A large group surges, overturns a table (f2–f3), and engages in chaotic collective pushing, shoving, and crowding across the room with no clear pairwise combatants.

events.description: A man in a beige jacket (white undershirt) is physically restrained and grappled by multiple individuals including uniformed officers, with visible mutual struggle and pulling.
